changelog: **The weekly analytics e-mail is a report subscription** (#1905, part 3; docs/report-subscriptions.md). `sendWeeklyAnalyticsReport()`, `weeklyAnalyticsStats()`, its Monday cron, `GET /api/cron?job=analytics-report` and the `analyticsReportEmail` strings are removed. New registry report `pipeline-summary` (totals, reached the final stage with share, new records and interactions in the last 7 days, every stage with its share — stage labels in the reader's language). Every active admin of an org with `ADVANCED_ANALYTICS` is seeded one weekly `pipeline-summary` subscription (Monday 08:00 UTC, their own language) by `seedLegacyWeeklyReports()` at the start of each job pass — once per org (a `Setting` claim), only while entitled (an org that gains the tier later is seeded then), with the period of the swap recorded as `SKIPPED · seeded` so nobody is mailed twice. Opt-outs keep applying; a deleted subscription stays deleted. The all-jobs `GET /api/cron` now reports `reportSubscriptions` for the caller's org instead of `analyticsReport`. Covered by `e2e/scheduled-analytics-report.spec.ts` (rewritten), `e2e/world-cron-builders.spec.ts` and `e2e/custom-pipeline-terminal-stages.spec.ts`.

en: The weekly analytics e-mail is now a scheduled report you can manage: every admin who received it keeps it, in their own language, and can change the day, the format or unsubscribe on the Scheduled reports page.
tr: Haftalık analiz e-postası artık yönetebileceğiniz bir zamanlanmış rapor: onu alan her yönetici kendi dilinde almaya devam ediyor ve günü, biçimi değiştirebilir ya da Zamanlanmış raporlar sayfasından abonelikten çıkabilir.
de: Die wöchentliche Analyse-E-Mail ist jetzt ein geplanter Bericht, den Sie verwalten können: Alle Admins, die sie bisher erhielten, bekommen sie weiter in ihrer Sprache und können Tag und Format ändern oder sie auf der Seite „Geplante Berichte“ abbestellen.
